item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Whether cleanup means removing countertop clutter or changing the kitchen's appearance.

item.title: Clean Up This Kitchen
item.tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

answer_sheet.Meaning of cleanup: Clear the loose clutter off the counter, not a renovation.
answer_sheet.Permanent kitchen features: Keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Keep it a realistic photo with the same wide framing; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.

turns.text: Can you clean up this kitchen pic by clearing the loose clutter off the counter, rather than doing a renovation? I keep getting distracted by the mess when I look at it, so I’d love to see it tidied up. You can decide which loose items to remove, but please keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout as they are. I just mean a cleanup of what’s sitting out, with the image staying a realistic photo in the same wide framing. Free-tier resolution is fine.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the cleanup because Magic Hour reported insufficient credits, even at free-tier resolution. No image was created.

The edit is ready to retry: remove the loose clutter while preserving the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material, layout, and original wide framing—no renovation.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Tidy this existing kitchen photograph by removing loose clutter only. Clear the countertops and sink basins of loose dishes, plates, bowls, cups, food packaging, bags, cloths, cleaning bottles, cans, paper towel roll and other small items sitting out. Reconstruct the newly visible counter surfaces and sink interiors naturally using the existing materials. Preserve exactly the original brown wooden cabinets and their wear, handles, beige tiled backsplash and grout, original countertop material and color, all sinks and faucets, window, outlets, architectural details, kitchen layout, lighting, camera position and same wide framing. Do not renovate, replace finishes, recolor, redesign, add decor or modernize anything. Result should look like the same realistic photo after someone put away the loose clutter, with no other changes.

timeline.text:
**Finding a solution for aspect ratio**

I need to deal with an unavailable account tool, so I'll stick to the known plan. The aspect tool suggests a ratio of 16:9, but the original is around 1.67. I have to preserve that somehow. It returned a clearer 16:9, which I must use. The photo's dimensions are roughly 512307, not fitting 16:9. I think using auto preservation for the user is the best choice here and will just go with that.
I’ll remove the loose countertop clutter while keeping the cabinets, tiles, countertops, layout, and original framing unchanged.
